parameters.description: 8 to 128 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore and hyphen. A resend with the same key and bytes returns the stored response.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: true when this is a stored response being replayed.

parameters.name: outstanding
parameters.description: When true, only claims the Reporting outstanding dashboard counts (every status except Rejected and Settled). Combines with the other filters; an explicit status of Rejected or Settled is rejected with 400.

parameters.name: claimNumber
parameters.description: Case-insensitive contains match on the claim number, trimmed, 1 to 40 characters.

parameters.name: minAmount
parameters.description: Estimated amount, in the claim's own currency, at least this value (zero or more).

parameters.name: maxAmount
parameters.description: Estimated amount, in the claim's own currency, at most this value. Must not be below minAmount.

parameters.name: submittedFrom
parameters.description: Submitted on or after this UTC date (inclusive).

parameters.name: submittedTo
parameters.description: Submitted on or before this UTC date (inclusive). Must not be before submittedFrom.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Defaults to newest, or to oldest (open proposal age, then claim number) when status is PendingDecisionApproval.
